tests.note: Unchanged. The files and formats are the same as before. The memory map in tb_top.sv is unchanged: IMEM at 0x0 (32 KB) and DMEM at 0x1000_0000 (256 KB). The plusargs come from mnist.plusargs.
Unchanged. It uses the same files as TC-056. The image file holds 100 images of 196 words, and the expected-results file holds 100 x 11 words.

summary:
I changed nothing in `src/sw/`. The `tb_top.sv` change doesn't affect any file the tests read, and the build reports clean (make had nothing to rebuild).

In `tb_top.sv` the file-reading helper `tb_readmem` still loads hex text into a 65,536-word buffer. The IMEM and DMEM base addresses are the same. The 25,100-word DMEM image still fits the 256 KB DMEM. Only TC-056 and TC-057 read files. They take them from `build/tb/programs`, or from `+VEC_DIR`. Their own code is unchanged.

The MNIST data is still synthetic, as in the last run. Trained weights can be passed with `make MODEL=<file.npz>`. I did not open the generated files.
